A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (23 December 2022). Its words are the Players Committee's errata for this card; Decipher published no errata text for it.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-D-comscandetection-PC-Errata-D-E1-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[ComScan Detection (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (by 8 July 2018): The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels: sharper art and frame, lore and game text set again, and the mark “D-E1” in place of “E”. The game text now reads: “If opponent just moved a character, vehicle, or starship as a ‘react’ to a location, you may immediately move one vehicle or starship, if within range, to that location (as a regular move).” (a comma is added after “vehicle”).

The whole earlier card image and the whole of this card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
